resources.string: A simple and elegant way to keep track of your thoughts, feelings, and more.\n\nDreamCode Notes is your personal digital sanctuary, where your ideas flourish and your privacy is protected. Designed for clarity and focus, it allows you to capture everything from fleeting inspirations to your most private reflections with ease and peace of mind.

Key Features:
• 📁 Effortless Category Organization
• ⏰ Precise Reminders to keep you on track
• 🔐 Secure Biometric Vault (Fingerprint/Face ID)
• 📝 Rich Text Formatting & Interactive Checklists
• 📤 Advanced Note Sharing as Text or Branded Image
Developed with ❤️ by Juan Quintero & Gemini
